research_notes: Identity: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk (unchanged legal name in FS2019-9M2026), integrated poultry feed/breeding/commercial farm/processing, aquaculture, beef and consumer foods (So Good). Majority shareholder Japfa Pte. Ltd. (55.43% at 31 Dec 2025, 56.34% at 30 Sep 2026 after buying the treasury shares; 9M2026 FS Note 28, PDF p. 117).
Currency/units: IDR reporter; every FS (2019-9M2026) is in Rp juta, divided by 1,000 to IDR billion. EBITDA comes from the decks, printed in IDR billion.

FY2019 RESTATEMENT (So Good Food): PT So Good Food (SGF) was bought from Jupiter Foods Pte Ltd (Japfa group) effective 30 Nov 2020 for Rp1,214,132m (Rp364,222m cash + Rp849,892m promissory note) - a business combination under common control. FS2020 restates 2019 and 2018 as if SGF had always been combined (FS2020 Note 4, PDF p. 83-84; Note 1c PDF p. 24). fy.2019 stores these RESTATED comparatives so that 2020-vs-2019 growth is like-for-like (the company's FY2020 deck also compares with restated 2019: revenue -4.9%); the originally reported FY2019 figures are in each datum's note (revenue 36,742,561 vs 38,872,084 restated; profit attributable unchanged at 1,765,178).

FY2020 P&L presentation: FS2020 shows 'profit after effect of merging entity's income adjustment' (1,221,904, incl. SGF's pre-acquisition result) and 'profit before effect...' (1,002,376); the stored net_profit_attr 916,711 is the latter's owners' share, which FS2021/FS2022 print as the 2020 comparative and EPS 79 uses. ROE/ROA (AR) and the deck's PAT (1,222) use 1,221,904.

Source policy: FY2020-FY2025 levels/profit/EPS/cash flow from each year's own audited FS. Later comparatives were checked: FS2021-FS2025 and 9M2026 reproduce the prior-year totals unchanged (no restatement after the FY2019 SGF restatement).

Operating profit: stored = FS 'Laba usaha' (includes other income/expenses and biological-asset FV changes). The investor decks print a different 'Operating Profit' = gross profit - selling - G&A (e.g. FY2025 6,150 vs Laba usaha 6,183.6; FY2020 2,635 vs 2,484.2).

EBITDA: only as printed in the FY investor decks (no definition printed; FY2019 restated 4,139 in the FY2020 deck). Rough check (not used): FS 'Laba usaha' + segment depreciation (FS2025 PDF p. 148: 1,265,023) = 7,448.6 vs reported 7,429 for 2025. FY2021 EBITDA includes a one-off IDR 372bn other income (pension law change) per the FY2022 deck.

total_debt = bank loans + bonds/notes + the small 'utang pembiayaan atas perolehan aset tetap' (non-bank equipment/vehicle financing, Rp1-10bn), current + non-current, excluding PSAK 73 lease liabilities. It reconciles exactly to the company's own 'Total Interest Bearing Debt' minus lease liabilities for every year checked (2019, 2020, 2021, 2024, 2025, 9M2026). The FY2020 Rp849.9bn promissory note to Jupiter Foods (other payables - related party) is excluded, as in the company's figure.

Bonds history: at end-2020 US Dollar notes of US$250m (5.5% Senior Notes due 2022) and Rupiah Obligasi Berkelanjutan II Japfa (nominal 1,150,000; the last Rp1,000,000 tranche matured 21 Apr 2022, FS2021 Note 22 PDF p. 124-125); US$350m 5.375% sustainability-linked Guaranteed Senior Notes due 23 Mar 2026 issued 23 Mar 2021 (partly to repay the 2022 notes), US$2m bought back; repaid in 2026 (9M2026 cash flow 'Payments of bonds payables' 5,921,650) largely with bank loans; new Rupiah bonds nominal 500,000 issued in 2026 (9M2026 Note 25, PDF p. 111).

capex = 'Penambahan aset tetap' + 'Penambahan aset biologis' (non-current biological assets shown in investing activities in 2020-2022; none from 2023). Land for development and right-of-use additions are excluded (amounts in the notes). The decks' CAPEX figures differ (e.g. FY2025 2,391 vs FS additions 2,467.5; FY2020 1,645 vs 1,614.9).

Dividends (all cash, rupiah): FY2019 Rp20 (paid Jul 2020, outside the series); FY2020 Rp40 final; FY2021 Rp60 final; FY2022 Rp50 final; FY2023 NONE (AGMS 3 Apr 2024); FY2024 Rp70 interim (Oct 2024) + Rp70 'additional' final (Apr 2025) = Rp140; FY2025 Rp140 final (AGMS 29 Apr 2026, no interim); FY2026 Rp90 interim (ex 6 Nov 2026, pay 12 Nov 2026). Dates come from the company's AGMS summaries / IDX schedule forms. Conflict: FY2025 final payment 19 May 2026 (AGMS summary and IDX form) vs 'paid on 15 May 2026' in 9M2026 FS Note 38 - 19 May stored.

Payout ratio: FY2020-FY2022 as printed in the AR dividend tables (the company uses DPS/EPS: 50.63%, 34.5%, 40.9%); FY2023 0 (no dividend). FY2024 and FY2025 have no printed full-year ratio: stored 53.92% and 40.66% = total dividend / profit attributable, both amounts printed in the AGMS resolution / IDX form. AR2024/AR2025 print 55.0% per Rp70 payment against 1H2024 profit, and AR2025's dividend table is mislabelled (its '2025' column is the FY2024 additional dividend paid Apr 2025; the interim column says '9 October 2025 / 29 October 2025' for the 2024 dates).

Treasury shares (shares_out is net of them): 7,361,200 at end-2019; 2020 buybacks (from 19 Mar 2020 under the OJK volatile-market rule, then under the EGMS mandate of 18 Jun 2020) to 68,884,600; 106,266,500 at end-2021 and end-2022 (bought in 2021 under the June-2020 mandate; none bought under the April-2022 mandate); 7,361,200 resold Jul-Aug 2023 -> 98,905,300 at end-2023/2024/2025; all 98,905,300 sold to parent Japfa Pte. Ltd. on 26 May 2026 (disclosure 11 May 2026; cash flow 'Penjualan treasuri stock' 259,284); 21,704,500 bought back by 30 Sep 2026 under the 29 Apr 2026 EGMS mandate (max 1.5%, until 29 Apr 2027). Sources: 9M2026 FS Note 28 (PDF p. 117-121).

Corporate actions 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-04: NONE (no split, reverse split, bonus or rights issue). Issued shares are 11,726,575,201 (8,814,985,201 Series A par Rp200 + 2,911,590,000 Series B par Rp40, equal rights) in every FS from 31 Dec 2018 to 30 Sep 2026. AR2025 share chronology (PDF p. 12): last changes were the 1:5 split of 19 Apr 2013 and private placements of 750,000,000 shares (4 Aug 2016) and 316,052,291 shares (8 Jun 2018). The 2020 rights-issue mandate (up to 3,517,972,560 Series A shares, disclosure 5 May 2020) and the 2023 PMTHMETD (non-pre-emptive) mandate (disclosure 27 Feb 2023) were never executed - the issued share count never changed. FY2019 year_end_price is therefore not needed.

2026 events visible in the 9M2026 FS: VSN (PT Vaksindo Satwa Nusantara with Vaksindo Animal Health Pvt Ltd and Vaksindo Vietnam Animal Health) sold on 29 Sep 2026 to Japfa Pte. Ltd. and Bionovus Pte. Ltd. for Rp1,807,389m plus Rp1,000,000m shareholder-loan repayment; common control, so +928,239 to APIC (after 391,029 tax in equity) and no P&L gain (Note 1c, PDF p. 16). Operating cash flow 9M2026 was -4,558,141; inventories 14.4 tn and short-term bank loans 12.4 tn at 30 Sep 2026 (vs 9.6 tn and 2.9 tn at end-2025).
Year-end prices are the Q4 closes printed in each year's AR 'Ikhtisar Saham' table (and repeated in the next AR). No price file exists yet for JPFA, so the price_year_end cross-check was not run.
ROE/ROA are as printed in each AR's 'Rasio Keuangan Penting' (profit for the year incl. NCI / year-end total equity or total assets) - not on profit attributable to owners.
